description_en: Queries the server certificates of a TCPSSL listener
description_zh: 查询TCPSSL监听的服务器证书
name: ListListenerCertificates

parameters.help_en: The listener ID. This parameter is valid only for TCPSSL listeners
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

Ca: CA certificate.
Server: Server certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

Ca：CA证书。
Server：服务器证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token for the next query.
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no subsequent query is required.
For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The server certificates. You can add only one server certificate.

This parameter takes effect only for TCPSSL listeners
parameters.help_zh:
服务器证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加 1 个服务器证书。

仅对 TCPSSL 监听生效
parameters.name: certificate_ids

CertificateId.description_en: The certificate ID. Only server certificates are supported
CertificateId.description_zh: 证书ID，当前仅支持服务器证书

IsDefault.description_en:
Specifies whether the certificate is the default certificate for the listener. Valid values:

true: The certificate is the default certificate.

false: The certificate is an additional certificate
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为监听默认证书。取值：

true：默认证书。

false：扩展证书

Status.description_en:
The association status between the certificate and the listener. Valid values:

Associating: The certificate is being associated.

Associated: The certificate is associated.

Diassociating: The certificate is being dissociated
Status.description_zh:
证书与监听关联的状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。

Associated：已关联。

Diassociating：解除关联中
Status.title_en: 证书与监听关联的状态
Status.title_zh: 证书与监听关联的状态

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token for the next query.
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no subsequent query is required.
For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
